blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Pangilinan Group is taking bolder steps to meet the growing data center market’s power needs by exploring ways to power these facilities with clean electricity.hungry facilities with clean electricity. Meralco PowerGen Corp. (MGEN), and PLDT’s Vitro Inc. have partnered to launch a feasibility study for “sustainable” digital infrastructure in the country. READ: MGEN bullish on 10,000-MW capacity goal Under the pact, both parties would conduct joint technical and commercial studies to assess potential sites, power generation capacity, renewable energy resources, connectivity requirements, data center specifications, and commercial structures.
